soldier: Head yellowish brown, the tip of the nasus reddish brown, the base of the nasus and the antennae brownish yellow, thorax and abdomen pale brownish yellow, legs pale yellow; head nearly bare, the tip of the nasus with a few short hairs. Large form: head flattened-round, wider than long, the middle of the sides bulging, the posterior margin broadly rounded; nasus a stout cone, shorter than the head, slightly upturned in profile with the tip about level with the top of the head, the base of the nasus shallowly concave, the angle between nasus and head slightly greater than 110°; apical spine of the mandibles short and small. Antennae 13 segments, the second the shortest, the third about twice the second, the fourth slightly longer than the second. The anterior raised part of the pronotum strongly sclerotised and with a median incision. Small form: pilosity as in the large form but paler; head circular and slightly long, longer than wide, nasus shorter than the head, slightly upturned in profile with the tip about level with the top of the head, the base of the nasus rather deeply concave, the angle about 110°; antennae 12 segments, the second the shortest, the third about 1.5 times the second, the fourth shorter and stouter than the third; anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum nearly straight.
